Breads.name: ⭐ Banana Bread - Grandma Peggy
Breads.subtitle: Grandma Peggy
directions: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
In a large bowl, cream together the butter and sugar until light and fluffy.
Add the bananas, eggs, and vanilla. Mix just until combined—do not overmix.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, baking soda, and salt.
Gradually add the dry ingredients to the banana mixture, alternating with the buttermilk, and mix until just combined.
Fold in chocolate chips or walnuts, if desired.
Pour the batter into a greased loaf pan and bake for 1 to 1½ hours, or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
If dividing the batter between two pans, bake for about 1 hour.

Breads.name: Banana Bread Bites

ingredients.item: agave syrup, maple syrup or honey
avocado oil or extra-virgin olive oil

Breads.subtitle: minimalistbaker.com
directions: Preheat the oven to 375°F.
In a large bowl, mash the bananas. Add the baking soda, baking powder, salt, flaxseed, vanilla, almond butter, agave syrup, and avocado oil. Mix until well combined.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour and oats.
Add the dry ingredients to the banana mixture and stir until just combined. Fold in the chocolate chips.
Chill the dough in the refrigerator (or freezer) for 20 minutes.
Using a mini cookie scoop, portion the dough onto a lined baking sheet.
Bake for 8 minutes. Remove from the oven, gently flatten the cookies, then return to the oven and bake for an additional 2 minutes.

Breads.name: Zucchini Bread

ingredients.item: Optional: chocolate chips or chopped nuts

Breads.subtitle: Rose Smith
directions: Preheat the oven to 350°F and grease two bread pans.
In a large bowl, sift together the flour, salt, baking soda, and baking powder. Mix well.
In a separate large bowl, combine the eggs, sugar, brown sugar, vanilla, cinnamon, and applesauce. Mix until well combined.
Add the wet ingredients to the flour mixture and mix until just combined.
Lightly squeeze excess moisture from the shredded zucchini and fold it into the batter.
Optional: Sprinkle chocolate chips or chopped nuts over the batter before baking.
Pour the batter evenly into the prepared bread pans.
Bake for about 1 hour, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Bake for about 30 minutes for mini loaves, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.

Canning.name: Canned Rotel

ingredients.note: 1/4 tsp for each pint, 1/2 tsp for quarts or 1 TBSP bottled lemon juice for pints (2 TBSP for quarts)

Canning.subtitle: AnOregonCottage.com
directions: Wash, core, and blanch the tomatoes in the large stockpot, removing them to a large bowl in batches. When done, empty then and peel and quarter tomatoes, adding them to the stockpot as you go.
Wash, stem, and seed chilies (leave the seeds to increases spiciness if you’d like). Finely chop by hand or cut into large pieces and finely chop in a food processor.
Add chilies, salt, pepper, oregano, and coriander to tomatoes in stockpot, bring to a low boil, reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
While tomato mixture is simmering, prepare canner, jars and lids (see note for a tutorial for water-bath canning).
To clean, hot, pint canning jars, add 1/4 teaspoon citric acid or 1 tablespoon lemon juice (if using quart jars, add 1/2 teaspoon citric acid or 2 tablespoons lemon juice).
Ladle the tomato-chili mixture into each jar, leaving 1/2-inch headspace. Remove bubbles with a spatula, wipe rims, and attach lids.

Add jars to canner, cover, bring to a boil and process 40 minutes for pints (50 minutes for quarts), adjusting heat as needed to maintain a soft boil. When timer goes off, remove lid, turn off heat and allow jars to sit in canner 5 minutes.

Remove jars from canner to a towel-lined counter and let cool 12 to 24 hours. Remove rings for storage and check lids to be sure they’ve sealed (gently pull up with your fingers). Refrigerate any that didn’t seal.
Tips: Use 10 oz canning jars to replicate the size of Rotel cans.  Process the same as pints.

Canning.name: Canned Spaghetti Sauce

ingredients.note: will be added in small amounts to jars

Canning.subtitle: FavFamilyRecipes.com
directions: Fill a large pot or Dutch oven halfway with water and bring it to a boil. Working in batches, add tomatoes and boil for 1 to 2 minutes, or until the skins begin to split.

Remove the tomatoes with a slotted spoon and place them in an ice water bath. Peel and quarter the tomatoes over a large bowl so you save the juices. Remove the tough stem area. The tomatoes do not need to be seeded.

In a food processor, pulse the onions and bell peppers in batches until finely chopped. For extra flavor, you can sauté the peppers and onions in a little oil with a pinch of salt before adding them to the sauce.
In a large stockpot, combine the tomatoes, onion and pepper mixture, tomato paste, soy sauce, Worcestershire sauce, brown sugar, salt, garlic, oregano, basil, red pepper flakes, and bay leaves.

Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 4 to 5 hours, stirring every 15 minutes or so to prevent scorching. Remove and discard the bay leaves. For a smoother sauce, use an immersion blender to blend until smooth.

Add 2 tablespoons bottled lemon juice to each hot quart jar, or 1 tablespoon bottled lemon juice to each hot pint jar. Ladle hot sauce into hot jars, leaving ½ inch headspace. Remove air bubbles, wipe rims clean, and add lids and rings.
Note: Do not forget the lemon juice! If you forget to add the lemon juice you will need to open the jars, add the juice, replace with new lids, and reprocess.

For Water Bath Canning:

Process quart jars for 40 minutes in a boiling-water canner for altitudes of 1,000 feet or less. Adjust processing time for higher altitudes:
1,001 to 3,000 feet: add 5 minutes
3,001 to 6,000 feet: add 10 minutes
6,001 to 8,000 feet: add 15 minutes
8,001 to 10,000 feet: add 20 minutes

Dips.name: Bacon Dip
directions: In a large bowl, combine the bacon, mayonnaise, sour cream, hot sauce, green onion, parsley, mustard powder, and cheddar cheese. Mix until well blended.
Cover and refrigerate for 1–2 hours before serving to allow the flavors to develop.

Dips.name: Bagel Dip
Dips.subtitle: Renae Loy
directions: In a large bowl, combine the mayonnaise, sour cream, dill, parsley, and green onion. Mix until well blended, then fold in the dried beef until evenly incorporated.

Dips.name: Buffalo Chicken Dip
Dips.subtitle: Alicia Smith
directions: Drain the liquid from the canned chicken.
Add all ingredients to a crockpot set to High. Stir occasionally until the cream cheese is fully melted and the mixture is heated through.
Reduce heat to Warm and serve with tortilla chips.

Dips.name: Corn Dip
Dips.subtitle: Jesi Fuller
directions: In a large bowl, combine the corn, jalapeños, onion, mayo, cheddar cheese, salt, pepper, and garlic. Mix until well blended.

Dips.name: Dunkaroo Dip
directions: In a large bowl, combine the vanilla yogurt and whipped topping. Mix until smooth and well blended.
Stir in the funfetti cake mix and sprinkles until evenly incorporated.
Refrigerate until ready to serve.
Serve with graham crackers.

Dips.name: Jalapeno Corn Dip
directions: In a large bowl, combine the sour cream, mayonnaise, salsa, black pepper, garlic powder, corn, and jalapeños. Mix until well blended, then fold in the cheddar cheese.

Dips.name: Jalapeno Popper Dip
directions: In a large bowl, combine the cream cheese and mayonnaise. Mix until smooth.
Stir in the green chiles, jalapeños, and Parmesan cheese until well blended.
Serve chilled, if desired.

Optional – Warm Version: Transfer to a microwave-safe dish, top with additional cheese, and microwave on High for 3 minutes. Alternatively, place in an oven-safe dish and bake at 375°F for 30 minutes.

Dips.name: Mexican Corn Dip

ingredients.note: 11oz or 15.25oz cans Mexican or Southwest sweet corn - drained

Dips.subtitle: Tammy Kuhlmann
directions: In a large bowl, combine the mayonnaise, sour cream, corn, and Rotel. Mix until well blended.
Fold in the cheddar cheese, green onions, and cilantro until evenly incorporated.

Dips.name: Pickle Wrap Dip
Dips.subtitle: Alicia Smith
directions: In a large bowl, combine the sour cream and cream cheese. Mix until smooth and well blended.
Stir in the dried beef and pickles until evenly incorporated. Add a small amount of pickle juice, if desired, to enhance the flavor.

Dips.name: Pumpkin Harvest Dip

ingredients.item: apples, graham crackers, or ginger snaps

Dips.subtitle: Rebekah Sanford
directions: In a large bowl, beat the cream cheese and powdered sugar until smooth and well combined.
Add the pumpkin puree, pumpkin spice, vanilla, and ginger. Mix until fully incorporated.
Refrigerate for 1–2 hours, then serve with apples or crackers.

Dips.name: Pumpkin Pie Dip
directions: Add the cottage cheese to a blender and blend for 30–60 seconds until completely smooth.
Add the pumpkin puree, vanilla extract, pumpkin pie spice, maple syrup, and a pinch of salt (optional). Blend again until smooth and creamy.
Taste and adjust sweetness with additional maple syrup if desired.

Dips.name: ⭐ White Queso
Dips.subtitle: eatingonadime.com
directions: In a saucepan over low heat, combine the cheese, evaporated milk, and butter. Stir frequently until melted and smooth.
Stir in the green chiles, cumin, garlic powder, and cayenne pepper until well incorporated.
Add additional evaporated milk as needed to reach your desired consistency.

Dressings.name: Caesar Dressing
Dressings.subtitle: Pam Woods
directions: In a small bowl, mash the garlic and salt together until a smooth paste forms.
Whisk in the lemon juice, mayonnaise, Worcestershire sauce, anchovy fillets, and black pepper until well combined.
While whisking continuously, slowly drizzle in the extra-virgin olive oil until the dressing is smooth and emulsified.

Misc..name: Almond Flour
directions: Preheat the oven to 200°F.
Spread the wet almond pulp evenly onto a lined baking sheet.
Bake for 1–2 hours, stirring every 30 minutes, until fully dried.
Some clumping is normal and will be resolved during processing.
Transfer the dried pulp to a food processor and process until finely ground.
Store in an airtight glass container.

Misc..name: Almond Milk
directions: Soak the almonds in filtered water for 10–12 hours.
Drain and rinse thoroughly with cold water.
Blend 1 cup soaked almonds with 2 cups filtered water until the mixture is as smooth as possible.
Strain the mixture through a nut milk bag, squeezing out as much liquid as possible into a bowl or jar.
Do not discard the leftover pulp. Reserve it for homemade almond flour (see almond flour recipe).
For a sweeter milk, stir in stevia and vanilla to taste.
Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for 7–10 days. Shake well before each use.

Misc..name: Bourbon Butter

ingredients.item: Maker's Mark or bourbon of choice

Misc..subtitle: Traeger.com
directions: In a bowl, combine the butter, garlic, bourbon, green onion, parsley, salt, and pepper. Mix until well blended.

Misc..name: Caramel Popcorn Balls

ingredients.item: Optional: M&M's, nuts, sea salt, or melted chocolate

directions: In a large saucepan, melt the butter, brown sugar, and corn syrup. Bring the mixture to a boil.

Once boiling, reduce the heat to medium and add the sweetened condensed milk. Cook for 4–5 minutes, stirring frequently and scraping the bottom of the pan to prevent burning. Cook for about 4 minutes for a softer caramel.
Place the popcorn in a large bowl. Pour the caramel mixture over the popcorn and stir until evenly coated.
Lightly spray your hands with cooking spray and shape the popcorn into balls once it has cooled enough to handle.

Optional: Once the caramel popcorn has cooled slightly, mix in M&M’s, chopped nuts, or a sprinkle of sea salt before forming the popcorn balls. You can also drizzle melted chocolate over the finished popcorn balls.

Misc..name: Cinnamon Butter
Misc..subtitle: Copycat Texas Roadhouse
directions: For a creamy consistency, allow the butter to sit at room temperature for at least 1 hour until very soft. Do not microwave, as this can affect the texture.
In a medium bowl, combine the butter, powdered sugar, honey, and cinnamon. Mix until smooth. For an even smoother consistency, use a hand mixer.
Refrigerate until ready to use.

Misc..name: Dry Brine
directions: Rinse the chicken under cold water and pat dry thoroughly inside and out.
In a small bowl, combine the salt, sugar, and pepper. Rub the mixture all over the chicken, including inside the cavity and under the skin of the breasts.
Place the chicken on a baking sheet and refrigerate uncovered overnight, or for at least 8–12 hours.
Preheat the oven to 500°F and position the rack in the lowest setting.
Rinse off the brine under cold water and pat dry again inside and out.
Place the chicken breast-side up on a rack in a roasting pan. Let sit at room temperature for 30–60 minutes.
Rub softened butter all over the chicken, including under the skin of the breasts.
Tie the legs together with kitchen twine. Secure the twine around the body near the neck opening and tuck the wings underneath.
Add 1 cup water to the roasting pan. Roast for 30 minutes at 500°F, then reduce the oven temperature to 350°F and continue roasting for 1½ to 2 hours.
Rotate the pan after 1 hour. Roast until a thermometer inserted into the thickest part of the thigh registers 155°F.
Remove from the oven and let rest for 20 minutes before transferring to a cutting board to carve and serve.

Misc..name: ⭐ Protein Balls

ingredients.item: mini chocolate chips or mini M&M's

Misc..subtitle: Alicia Smith
directions: In a medium bowl, combine the quick oats and protein powder.
Stir in the peanut butter and honey until well combined.
Fold in the chocolate chips or M&M’s.
Roll into balls and store in the refrigerator.

Misc..name: Puppy Chow
Misc..subtitle: Alicia Smith
directions: In a microwave-safe bowl or saucepan, melt the peanut butter, chocolate chips, and butter until smooth.
In a large bowl, add 3 cups of cereal. Pour 1 cup of the chocolate mixture over the cereal and stir until evenly coated.
Repeat this process two more times until all of the cereal and chocolate mixture have been combined.
If there are pools of chocolate in the bottom of the bowl, add additional cereal if desired.
Let the mixture cool slightly in the refrigerator, then transfer it to a brown paper bag.
Add 1 cup of powdered sugar at a time, seal the bag, and shake until evenly coated.

Misc..name: Taco Seasoning
Misc..subtitle: Megan Corkrean
directions: In a small bowl, combine all ingredients and mix well.
Store in an airtight glass jar.
Use 3 tablespoons of seasoning per 1 pound of meat.

Misc..name: Turkey Tender Marinade
Misc..subtitle: Rainbow Drive In
directions: In a large bowl, whisk together the liquid aminos, cooking sherry, oil, lemon juice, black pepper, garlic powder, onion, and lemon-lime soda.
Place the turkey tenders in a large resealable plastic bag. Pour the marinade over the turkey, seal the bag, and refrigerate overnight.

Sauces.name: Cajun Dipping Sauce
Sauces.subtitle: Rainbow Drive In
directions: In a large bowl, combine the mayonnaise, sour cream, and Cajun seasoning. Mix until well blended.
Refrigerate before serving.

Sauces.name: Fish Taco Sauce
directions: In a small bowl, combine the mayonnaise, sour cream, lime juice, garlic powder, and chili powder. Mix until well blended.
Refrigerate before serving to allow the flavors to blend.

Sauces.name: ⭐ Honey Mustard
directions: In a small bowl, combine the mayonnaise, Dijon mustard, yellow mustard, honey, apple cider vinegar, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper. Whisk until smooth and well blended.
Refrigerate before serving to allow the flavors to blend.

Sauces.name: Margherita Pizza Sauce
directions: In a large skillet over medium-high heat, add the olive oil, onion, parsley, salt, and pepper. Cook until the onions are soft and lightly golden.
Stir in the garlic and oregano and cook for 30 seconds. Add the tomatoes, crushing them as they are added to the pan. Do not substitute crushed tomatoes.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the mixture has thickened.
Spread over pizza crust as desired. For canning, process in a water bath with lemon juice according to safe canning guidelines.

Sauces.name: Sweet and Sour Sauce
Sauces.subtitle: dinnerthendessert.com
directions: In a medium saucepan over medium heat, combine the pineapple juice, brown sugar, rice vinegar, ketchup, liquid aminos, and food coloring. Whisk frequently and bring to a boil.
In a separate bowl, mix the cornstarch and water. Add the mixture to the saucepan.
Whisk until the cornstarch is fully incorporated and the sauce has thickened to the desired consistency.
Allow the sauce to cool before serving.

Sauces.name: Tzatziki Sauce
directions: Grate the cucumber and squeeze out as much liquid as possible using a clean towel or paper towels.
In a large bowl, combine all ingredients and mix well.
Refrigerate for at least 1 hour, preferably overnight, to allow the flavors to develop.
Optional: Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with fresh dill before serving.

Sides.name: Applesauce
Sides.subtitle: Grandma Peggy
directions: Place the apples in a large pot with enough water to prevent sticking. Cook over medium heat until tender, then remove from heat.
Stir in the sugar, vanilla, and cinnamon until well combined.
For a traditional texture, leave the apples slightly chunky. (Grandma never mashed them.)
Ladle the mixture into sterilized jars. Process in a boiling water bath for 15 minutes to seal.
Optional – For a smoother, saucier version: Blend 1 cup applesauce using an immersion blender until smooth.
Stir in 1/8 teaspoon vanilla.
Add 1/8 teaspoon cinnamon.
Add 1/8 teaspoon nutmeg.

Sides.name: Avocado Chips - Keto
directions: In a large bowl, mix all ingredients together until evenly combined.
Preheat the air fryer to 400°F. Place the mixture in the basket in a single layer.
Cook for 4 minutes, then flip and cook for an additional 4 minutes, or until golden and cooked through.

Sides.name: Baked Boursin Spaghetti Squash

ingredients.item: Optional: red pepper flakes or balsamic glaze

ingredients.note: ground, grilled, air fried, or rotisserie and diced

Sides.subtitle: TikTok - @sam.movess
directions: Preheat the oven to 400°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Brush the spaghetti squash with olive oil until evenly coated and season with salt and pepper.
Place the spaghetti squash cut-side down on the baking sheet and bake for about 45 minutes, or until fork-tender.
If cooking chicken, heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken with salt, pepper, and Italian seasoning until fully cooked.

In the same skillet over medium heat, add the sun-dried tomatoes, spinach, basil, garlic, Boursin cheese, and heavy whipping cream. Optional: Add red pepper flakes. Stir often until the cheese is melted and the sauce is smooth.
Once the spaghetti squash is done, use a fork to loosen the strands from the shell. Discard the shell and add the squash strands to the cheese mixture.
Serve topped with fresh basil. Optional: Drizzle with balsamic glaze.

Sides.name: Broccoli Apple Pear Salad

ingredients.note: toasted or roasted if you want

directions: Add all vegetables, fruit and cashews to a bowl.
Combine mayo, sour cream (greek yogurt), honey, salt and lemon juice.  Mix together.
Add creamy dessing to bowl of vegetables, fruit and cashews.
Combine and serve chilled.
Sides.subtitle: Linda Benter

Sides.name: Ole Feller Beans
Sides.subtitle: Braden Crane
directions: In a large skillet over medium heat, brown the beef and bacon until fully cooked. Drain excess grease if needed.
Add the remaining ingredients and stir to combine.
Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 20–30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Alternatively, cook in a crockpot on Low for 6–8 hours.

Sides.name: Pinto Beans
Sides.subtitle: Joanne Zacharias
directions: In a large pot, add the pinto beans and water. Bring to a boil and cook for 15 minutes.
In a separate skillet, cook the bacon until slightly crispy. Remove the bacon and set aside, leaving some of the grease in the pan.
In the same skillet, add the onions, tomatoes, jalapeños, and cilantro. Cook until softened.
Add the bacon back to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the mixture to the beans and simmer for 15 minutes.
Serve topped with queso fresco.

Sides.name: Potato Salad
Sides.subtitle: Lisa Smith
directions: In a large pot, add the diced potatoes and cover with cold water. Bring to a boil and cook until the potatoes are about ¾ cooked.
Drain the water and run cold water over the potatoes to stop the cooking process.
Allow the potatoes to cool slightly.
Optional: While the potatoes are still warm, sprinkle with a small amount of vinegar and toss gently. This helps the potatoes absorb additional flavor.
In a medium bowl, combine the onion, salt, pepper, mayonnaise, mustard, vinegar, sugar, and eggs. Mix well, then refrigerate the mixture to allow the flavors to develop.
Place the potatoes in a large bowl and break them apart with a fork to the desired size.
Add the mayonnaise mixture to the potatoes and mix well. Refrigerate for 2–3 hours before serving.
Season with salt and pepper to taste before serving.

Sides.name: Quinoa Black Bean Salad
Sides.subtitle: Grandma Peggy
directions: In a large saucepan, combine the quinoa and water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes or until the water is absorbed. Remove from heat and let rest for 15–30 minutes before fluffing with a fork.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lime juice, cumin, and salt. Slowly drizzle in the olive oil while whisking until well combined. Set aside.
In a separate bowl, combine the black beans, red wine vinegar, and pepper. Mix well and set aside.
Once the quinoa has cooled, place it in a large bowl. Add the bell pepper, corn, cilantro, bean mixture, and dressing. Gently toss until well combined.

Sides.name: Sweet Potato Casserole
Sides.subtitle: Teresa Scheeler
directions: Preheat the oven to 350°F and grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.
In a large stockpot, add the sweet potatoes and cover with water. Do not peel the sweet potatoes. Bring to a boil and cook for 20–40 minutes, or until the sweet potatoes are fork-tender.
Drain the water and place the sweet potatoes on a cutting board to cool. Once cool enough to handle, peel and discard the skins, then place the sweet potatoes in a large mixing bowl.
Add the sugar, eggs, vanilla, butter, and milk. Mix with a hand mixer on low speed until smooth.
Spread the sweet potato mixture evenly into the prepared baking dish.
In a separate bowl, combine the brown sugar, flour, and pecans for the topping. Add the melted butter and mix with a fork until crumbly.
Sprinkle the topping evenly over the sweet potatoes and bake uncovered for 30–45 minutes.
Optional: Sprinkle mini marshmallows over the top during the last 5–10 minutes of baking and continue baking until the marshmallows are lightly golden.

Sides.name: Sweet Potatoes
directions: Preheat the oven to 400°F.
In a large bowl, toss the sweet potatoes with the oil until evenly coated.
Add the desired seasoning option and mix well.
Spread the sweet potatoes onto a baking sheet and bake for 20–40 minutes, or until fork-tender.

Sides.name: Sweet Potatoes Gratin
Sides.subtitle: Doris Tritle
directions: Preheat the oven to 400°F and grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.
In a medium saucepan, combine the heavy whipping cream, milk, butter, and garlic. Bring to a gentle simmer.
Remove from heat and stir in the parsley, thyme, sage, rosemary, salt, and pepper.

Arrange half of the sweet potatoes in the bottom of the prepared baking dish. Pour half of the milk mixture over the potatoes and sprinkle with half of the Gruyère cheese. Repeat the layers with the remaining sweet potatoes, milk mixture, and cheese.
Cover the pan with foil and bake for 30 minutes. Remove the foil and bake for an additional 15 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender and the top is bubbly and golden brown.
Let the dish stand for about 10 minutes before serving. Optional: Top with fresh herbs.

Sides.name: Vermicelli Pasta Salad
Sides.subtitle: Wendy Jones
directions: In a medium saucepan, cook the pasta until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large bowl, combine the Ac'cent, Lawry’s seasoning, lemon juice, and oil. Add the spaghetti and mix well. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, preferably overnight, to enhance the flavor.
Remove the pasta from the refrigerator. Add the pimentos, bell peppers, red onion, celery, black olives, and mayonnaise. Mix until well combined.
Refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving.
